guides.citation: Lawrence and Venkatesh, "Diophantine problems and p-adic period mappings", Inventiones mathematicae 221 (2020)

routes.summary: a new roadmap, The Mordell conjecture after Lawrence and Venkatesh (DESIGN-LV): nothing in the atlas followed this proof

guides.citation: Boxer, Calegari, Gee and Pilloni, "Abelian surfaces over totally real fields are potentially modular" (arXiv:1812.09269)

routes.summary: a new roadmap (DESIGN-BCGP18) importing Siegel and PEL moduli, toroidal compactifications, Galois deformation rings, patching, potential modularity and Hida and Coleman families from their roadmaps; higher Coleman theory, if missing, proposed as its own roadmap

guides.citation: Boxer, Calegari, Gee and Pilloni, "Modularity theorems for abelian surfaces" (arXiv:2502.20645)

routes.summary: a new roadmap (DESIGN-BCGP25) that builds on the roadmap for their 2018 paper and on the atlas's roadmaps for the ten-author infrastructure (arXiv:1812.09999)

guides.citation: Lue Pan, "On locally analytic vectors of the completed cohomology of modular curves II", Annals of Mathematics 203 (2026)

routes.summary: a Part II of Completed cohomology and p-adic local–global compatibility over Q (DESIGN-PAN): Pan's geometric route is new layers in that roadmap's direction; Pan's first paper, which the second continues, is covered first as its foundation

guides.citation: Christopher Skinner, "A converse to a theorem of Gross, Zagier, and Kolyvagin", Annals of Mathematics 191 (2020)

routes.summary: a Part II of Rank-zero and rank-one BSD (DESIGN-SKINNER): that roadmap proves the Gross–Zagier–Kolyvagin direction (BSD.3) but has no layer for the converse; Heegner points, Gross–Zagier and the main conjectures are imported

guides.citation: Balakrishnan, Dogra, Müller, Tuitman and Vonk, "Explicit Chabauty–Kim for the split Cartan modular curve of level 13", Annals of Mathematics 189 (2019)

routes.summary: a source of existing layers, no new roadmap: its theory belongs to NC.5 (quadratic Chabauty and height equations)
and its algorithm and the X_s(13) computation to ED.6 (explicit higher methods)

guides.citation: Betts and Stix, "Galois sections and p-adic period mappings", Annals of Mathematics 201 (2025)

routes.summary: a Part II of Anabelian geometry and nonabelian Chabauty (DESIGN-BETTS-STIX) that imports the p-adic period maps of the Lawrence–Venkatesh roadmap rather than planning them again
